title: LLM-Powered Benchmark Factory: Reliable, Generic, and Efficient

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating Pearson and partial correlations between LLM judge scores and evaluation factors like sample difficulty, sample length, and the length of the judge's rationale to identify bias, then using a multiple regression model with judge length as a covariate to compute debiased scores.

Substituting the benchmark generator models with a completely different, independent LLM (Qwen-Plus) to serve as the judge during evaluations, mitigating the tendency of models to favorably rate their own outputs.
